facts.text: The Go1 entry of ROBOT_SPECS declares an observation dimension of 48 and an action dimension of 12
The action space is a Box with low -1.0 and high 1.0 for every element, shape (action_dim,) and dtype float32
The observation space is a Box with low -inf and high inf, shape (observation_dim,) and dtype float32
A step sends the action to the UnrealCV server and returns (observation, 0.0, False, info): the reward is always 0.0 and the environment signals neither termination nor truncation
A reset sets steps to 0, clears last_action, rebuilds the robot state and returns the first observation
UnrealCvMujocoEnv.reset takes no seed and no options parameter
UnrealMujoco-Go1-v0 registers the entry point gym_unrealcv.envs:UnrealCvMujocoEnv with the robot keyword go1
The Go1 MuJoCo defaults are timestep 0.005 s and control_decimation 4
The control period is the physics timestep multiplied by control_decimation
The environment connects an unrealcv.Client to (host, port); it does not open a hardware device
The package dependencies pin gym 0.10.9 and unrealcv 1.3.2

determinism.notes: a seed passed to cap.world.reset.v1 reseeds the fake's initial joint offsets and repeats the trajectory for the same seed and actions; the upstream reset takes no seed (mujoco.py:314), so on the sim backend a seed only reaches legacy gym.Env.seed() and the upstream server decides the initial state

gaps: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction or actuator model: the fake advances 12 joint positions kinematically by action times the 0.005 s * 4 control period, and the action is the normalised Box value, not a torque or a target the upstream server would accept

the 48-element observation layout returned by the UnrealCV server is not reconstructed: the fake publishes the 12 joint positions, the 12 applied action values and 24 zeros, and was never compared with the upstream environment
no episode or task logic from a packaged UnrealZoo environment is modelled; the reward is always 0.0 and the environment never terminates, matching UnrealCvMujocoEnv.step (mujoco.py:388)
no Unreal Engine process, UnrealCV server, camera or rendering is modelled; the sim backend (gym.make with the upstream package and a running UnrealCV server) was not run
no validation against hardware or against the upstream environment: the model has never been compared with a real UnrealZoo run

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
